stories.title: India food inflation expected to stay high as RBI plans 25 bps rate hike
stories.summary: Food inflation in India is projected to remain elevated in the coming months due to a shortfall in crops. The Reserve Bank of India is anticipated to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in December to manage retail inflation. Weak monsoon conditions and high energy prices are contributing to upward price pressure on essential food items.

stories.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
stories.summary: The leading open-weight models developed by Chinese companies were trained on Nvidia chips that the U.S. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang left the company this week after admitting to his affair with Alice Huang, executive of Megaspeed, a company implicated in smuggling Nvidia chips into China.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
stories.previousTitle: Chinese open‑weight AI models trained on U.S.-banned Nvidia Blackwell GPUs
stories.previousSummary: A study by Will DePue of Unemployment Labs found that the weight structures of several open‑weight large language models released by Chinese firms—including DeepSeek, Moonshot AI, MiniMax and Ant Group—match the configuration fingerprints of Nvidia’s Blackwell GPUs, which are prohibited from export to China. The same article reports that Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned after acknowledging an affair with Alice Huang, who is alleged to have helped smuggle those chips.

stories.title: India bonds under pressure before debt supply; hot inflation prints pinch further
stories.summary: Indian government bonds experienced significant selling pressure ahead of a major auction for the benchmark paper. The yield on the 6.94% 2036 bond rose notably due to rising inflation in both India and the United States.

stories.title: US assures India lower tariffs than peers in trade deal
stories.summary: The United States told India that, under the proposed trade agreement, India will receive tariff rates that are lower than those applied to other U.S. trading partners. The first phase of the deal will focus on tariff reductions for goods, while tariff arrangements for services will be negotiated in a later phase.

stories.title: Report says uneven monsoons and El Nino raise upside inflation risks, could trigger RBI rate hike
stories.summary: A report warned that uneven monsoon rainfall across India and the emergence of an El Nino pattern create upside risks to consumer‑price inflation. It noted that these risks could increase the likelihood of the Reserve Bank of India implementing another interest‑rate hike to contain price pressures.

stories.previousSummary: A Nuvama Institutional Equities report says that uneven monsoon patterns and the prospect of El Nino conditions could increase food‑price inflation in India’s fiscal year 2027.
